text: Pad 3 floods in a hard rain. I raised it in '98. Check it before the wet season.

Rain by Thursday — my knee has never lied.
(Grandpa's forecast is noted.)
Hùng's scouts. Seat them near the noise — they'll complain either way, but happier near it.
Old Ba takes the water bank every time. Never once the hill. Some men are a river.
Chè trôi nước — sweet milk on rice, the offering bowl. He'd want it right on the night.
The dog found me before I found the camp. Feed a stray once and it decides for you.
Lan's mother photographed the valley every dusk. The girl has her eye — show her the good pads.
Tết at the river. Bánh chưng wraps better cold. Remember that when the kitchen rushes.
Three days of rain makes a camp of mud and friends. The fourth day makes storytellers.
A guest who asks for the water is telling you who they are. Read the card; seat the person.
The Minh family camps as one pad. Never split them — they came to be together, not to be guests.
Stoke the coals before they sit. A warm camp tips honest — I measured it once, 10 percent.
Cá kho: rice water, a slow fire, patience. Ba taught it to me — I taught the stove.
Sign your name in the back like I did. This book is a relay, not a grave.
